source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In two studies of NF1-associated MPNST (n=148 and n=130), median age at diagnosis was 33-34 years, about ten years younger than for sporadic MPNST.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC).
